posts.author: Tausi
posts.body:
Tausi Lighting
- v0.1.8
Author:
themelektaus
Source:
github.com/themelektaus/rpgmz-lighting-plugin
Introduction
Yet another
Lighting System
with an integrated
WYSIWYG editor
for RPG Maker MZ enables dynamic design of light sources directly within the editor. You can place lighting effects via drag-and-drop, utilize real-time previews, and visually adjust parameters such as color, intensity, radius or flickering without scripting knowledge.
Workflow Preview
Features
WYSIWYG Editor
Painting Tool
Ingame Overlay Panel
Based on WebGL Shader
Plugin Updater
Demo
tausi-lighting-demo-v0.1.6.zip
tausi-lighting-demo-v0.1.1.zip
Installation
Download
js/plugins/TausiLighting.js
(Right click - Save as...)
Place
TausiLighting.js
in the
js/plugin/
-folder of your project
Import it into plugin manager
Enable the plugin
Hints
There can only be one ambient light
Press and hold the right mouse button to use the eraser
Press and hold the middle mouse button for panning
Plugin Commands
Bind Switch
Bind Variable
Copy Event From
Interpolate
Known Issues
Slightly poorer quality when painting during overlay mode
Missing undo function
Terms and Credits
Can be used in commercial games
No credits needed
